title: Tikka Masala Shepherd's Pie
description: A British shepherd's pie with an Indian tikka masala filling: spiced chicken simmered in a tomato-butter sauce, baked under a blanket of buttery mashed potatoes.

ingredients.name: Kashmiri chili powder
ingredients.note: or 1/2 tsp mild paprika plus a pinch of cayenne

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.instruction: Cover the potatoes with salted water, bring to a boil and cook until completely tender, 12–15 minutes. Drain well, then mash with 60 g butter and the warm milk. Season with salt and pepper and set aside.

steps.title: Brown the chicken
steps.instruction: Heat a tablespoon of the remaining butter in a wide ovenproof pan or deep skillet over medium-high heat. Season the chicken with salt and brown it in batches until golden, about 5 minutes. Lift it out onto a plate; it does not need to be cooked through.

steps.title: Cook the masala
steps.instruction: Lower the heat to medium, add the last of the butter and the onion, and cook until soft, about 6 minutes. Stir in the garlic, ginger, garam masala, cumin, turmeric and chili powder for 1 minute, then the tomato purée for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Simmer the filling
steps.instruction: Pour in the crushed tomatoes and a splash of water, return the chicken and any juices, and simmer 10 minutes until the sauce is thick and the chicken is cooked through. Stir in the cream and yogurt, taste for salt, and take off the heat. Sprinkle in most of the cilantro.

steps.title: Bake the pie
steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200°C (400°F). If the pan is not ovenproof, tip the filling into a baking dish. Spoon the mash over the top, rough it up with a fork, and bake 20–25 minutes until the peaks are golden and the filling is bubbling. Rest 5 minutes and finish with the remaining cilantro.
